name: Medicine Ball V-Up
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight together and hold a medicine ball extended overhead with straight arms.
Brace your abs and simultaneously lift your straight legs and torso off the floor into a V shape.
Reach the medicine ball smoothly upward to touch your shins or ankles while balancing briefly on your glutes.
Lower your torso, arms, and legs slowly back toward the floor under control without slamming your heels.
tips: Press your lower back toward the floor at the bottom rather than overarching before the next lift.
Move smoothly with core control instead of heaving the ball wildly with momentum.
